notes.title: 关于免费开玩 About free to play
notes.notes:

由于操作失误ːsteamfacepalmː，添加了一个免费包，已经联系steam团队修正，可能需要几天的时间，[b] 期间游戏多人模式无法使用[/b]，很抱歉造成不便，请耐心等待，谢谢！

I added a free to play package accidentally. I have contacted steam to correct it, but it may take a few days. [b] Matchmaking will be unavailable temperarily[/b]. Sorry for the inconvenience! Thank you for your patience!
If you are interested in this game, you are also welcome to try it during this time!

notes.title: 每日游玩即可获得掉落 aka Daily award *New*
notes.notes:
每日游玩即可获得硬币一枚，还有机会获得稀有的山水地图。
为吸引更多玩家游玩，游戏计划增加折扣，掉落将在相应折扣之前结束作为对老玩家的补偿。
You can get a coin by playing everyday, and also chance to get a more valuable scenery map.
I am planning for more discounts so that more players try this game. The daily drop will stop before additional discounts as a compensation for early players.
